title: Sixty galaxy clusters become cosmic magnifying glasses for JWST
verifiedCoreFacts: About 4,500 multiple images fitted, about 1,150 newly identified with JWST
Median Einstein radius around 30 arcseconds at source redshift 9
Observed lensing radii compatible with cold dark matter model
